scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && concurrently "pnpm run dev:shell" "pnpm run dev:sales" "pnpm run dev:underwriter" "pnpm run dev:product"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: cd packages/shared-types && pnpm run build && cd ../shared-ui && pnpm run build
scripts.build:apps: concurrently "pnpm run build:shell" "pnpm run build:sales" "pnpm run build:underwriter" "pnpm run build:product"
scripts.preview: concurrently "pnpm run preview:shell" "pnpm run preview:sales" "pnpm run preview:underwriter" "pnpm run preview:product"
scripts.yarn:dev: concurrently "yarn workspace @insurance/shell dev" "yarn workspace @insurance/sales-portal dev" "yarn workspace @insurance/underwriter-portal dev" "yarn workspace @insurance/product-config dev"
